description: ZenMux 的 Magpie 适配插件：统一支持 Builder Plan（订阅制）与 Pay As You Go（按量付费），提供 5 小时 / 7 天滚动 Flow 额度、提前重置次数、按量余额查询、套餐模型自动过滤与多协议原生路由。｜Magpie provider plugin for ZenMux supporting Builder Plan subscriptions and Pay-As-You-Go keys, with 5h/7d Flow windows, reset counts, PAYG balance, per-plan model filtering, and native multi-protocol routing.
